Grumbl: The Fluffy Gargoyle Who's More 'Meh' Than 'Menacing'

Grumbl is a 4-star Ice (Blue) hero from the Gargoyle family, released during the "Return to Sanctuary" event in May 2024. Visually, he looks like a grumpy, multi-eyed Furby that got turned into stone and then woke up on the wrong side of the cathedral.
He occupies a strange niche: a

speed healer and cleanser who applies the coveted "Softskin" buff to his allies. While his legendary cousins (like the terrifying Mena or the sturdy Garten) dominate the 5-star meta, Grumbl tries to bring that same stone-skin magic to the Epic tier. But does he succeed? Well... as the saying goes, "Mustn't grumbl," but in this case, you might have a few complaints.

The art is undeniably unique. Grumbl breaks the mold of the "scary stone monster" aesthetic of the original Gargoyles (like Gaillard or Penolite) and leans heavily into the "weirdly cute but dangerous" vibe of the second wave. There was significant confusion about his Softskin. Players initially thought he gave the full 5-hit Softskin to allies (like the 5-stars do via passive), but quickly realized it was a watered-down version.

Grumbl is a cute addition to the Gargoyle family, but he feels like a statue that was left out in the rain too long—eroded and a bit soft. He has moments of brilliance in Rush Attack, but everywhere else, he's just too slow and too squishy to keep up with the modern pace of Empires & Puzzles. Keep him for the collection (and the cute factor), but don't expect him to rock your world.
A niche pick for Rush enthusiasts, a bench-warmer for everyone else.
